case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

You offered us a volume for the year, and what we can give you in return is a firm, long-term commitment. Option A is the package we can approve: it secures the full volume with you over a long contract term and gives you planning security, with a lead time that fits your capacity.

On the cost side:
Our cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).

On quality:
Your quality was 270 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM with you were placed at EUR 29.89 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011517-10), EUR 29.89 on 2025-05-19 (po:4500012472-10), EUR 29.89 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013451-10) and EUR 29.89 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014436-10): the price has been unchanged.

Given these points, Option A is the one we can approve, because it pairs a binding volume with a price that reflects them.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 28.50; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 42 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

For your pricing committee or management, in plain words: Option A gives Ravensteiner a binding volume for every year of a long contract, so your allocation can be planned with one reliable customer and no uncertainty on our side. Please take Option A to the pricing committee on that basis.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your cost and quality data; they justify only a marginal adjustment. We meet the agreed quality targets. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We accept the volume of 23,400 units and the 36-month contract term to support your planning requirements. Which volume can you commit to?

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot is a price of €33.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 56 days: €31.70 per unit.

This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

decision.intent: appreciative: we accept your alternative proposal as offered

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

You asked which volume we can commit to, and our answer is the full volume you named, bound over the whole contract term. That is the planning security you are looking for with your tight capacity.

We accept your alternative proposal as you offered it, with the longer lead time. Our terms are set out here:

Our proposal: unit price EUR 31.70; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 36 months; lead time 56 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 36 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you a binding volume over a long contract term and a lead time that fits your capacity, so you can plan with us without any open questions. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Thank you for taking our cost and quality points into account and for accepting the contract term.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
